_note: STRICT WHITELIST for the Jarvis voice layer. Nothing outside this file is ever executed. type=read_only runs a local zero-side-effect query immediately. type=gated runs an AGENT (LLM cost + outward-facing artifact) and NEVER fires without a separate confirm — CLAUDE.md §5 sends/publish/money/ad-spend are gated by law, and every other agent run is gated too because voice is a low-confidence input channel (mis-transcription must never cost a run). Edit + restart the server to change the whitelist.
_schema: id | description (what the classifier matches on) | phrases (examples, matching aid only) | type | run{tool,args|builtin|agent,task} | params{name:hint} | reply (spoken template, {placeholders} come from the summarizer or params)

commands.description: Health/status of the connected systems and integrations — GoHighLevel, n8n, AiSensy, Anthropic, Obsidian, etc. Is everything online, what is broken, systems check.
commands.reply: Systems check: {connected} of {total} connected. Needing attention: {issues}.

commands.description: How many agents exist in the OS and which ones — the agent roster, the team, who can I call on.
phrases: how many agents do I have
commands.reply: You have {count} agents on the roster, including {sample}.

commands.description: The recent agent run log — what has run lately, what the last agent run was, recent activity or history of the OS.
phrases: what have the agents been doing
commands.reply: Last run: {agent}, {status}. {summary}. {count} runs in the recent log.

commands.description: Size and shape of the OS knowledge base / brain — how many documents or words the OS knows, corpus stats.
phrases: how many documents do you know
commands.reply: The brain holds {documents} documents, about {words} words, across {sources} sources.

commands.description: Search the OS knowledge base for a specific topic and read back the best match. Use whenever Paras asks what the OS knows, says, or has written ABOUT a named subject.
phrases: what do we know about the founding price
search the brain for dead lead revival
find our notes on the realtor funnel

params.query: the topic or phrase to search for, in Paras's own words

commands.description: A short spoken business brief from the Chief of Staff — where things stand, what matters today, what to do next across the three communities and DFY.
phrases: what should I focus on today
commands.gate_reason: Runs the orchestrator, which plans and routes across the whole OS — never fire that on an unconfirmed transcript.

run.task: Give Paras a spoken-length brief (max 120 words, plain sentences, no markdown, no bullet characters): where the business stands right now, the single highest-leverage thing to do today, and one risk to watch. Ground it in the constitution and shared context only — do not invent metrics you were not given.

commands.summary: Have the orchestrator write today's business brief
commands.reply: Here's your brief. {preview} Full version is on the dashboard.

commands.description: Design or fix a nurture / follow-up / re-engagement sequence — webinar reminders, no-show recovery, HOT-WARM-COLD lane follow-up.
phrases: build the nurture for next week's webinar
commands.gate_reason: Produces WhatsApp/email copy destined to go out — CLAUDE.md §5 keeps anything on the send path behind an approval gate.

params.brief: what the sequence is for, in Paras's own words (audience, event, lane)

run.task:
Design the nurture sequence for this request: {brief}

Give the full message-by-message sequence with timing. These are DRAFTS awaiting Paras's approval — do not claim anything was sent.

commands.summary: Have the nurture-sequencer draft a follow-up sequence
commands.reply: The nurture sequencer has drafted it. {preview} Full sequence is on the dashboard, awaiting your approval before anything goes out.

commands.description: Anything about sending a WhatsApp or AiSensy message, broadcast, or template to the community or a lead list.
commands.gate_reason: CLAUDE.md §5 — WhatsApp broadcasts are approval-gated. Confirming here only produces the send-ready draft and the send plan; the actual API fire still needs Paras's explicit approved-send step.

params.brief: what the message is about and who it goes to

run.task:
Prepare this WhatsApp send: {brief}

Return the exact template/message copy, the audience, the timing, and the test-to-Paras-first plan. Do NOT claim the message was sent — this is a send-ready draft awaiting Paras's approval.

commands.summary: Have the AiSensy operator prepare a WhatsApp send (draft only)
commands.reply: Draft ready. {preview} It is staged on the dashboard — nothing has been sent, and the send itself still needs your approval.

commands.description: Create content — a post, script, editorial calendar, campaign message, or anything to be published on YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn or elsewhere.
phrases: write me a post about churn
draft a YouTube script on AI agents
commands.gate_reason: CLAUDE.md §5 — publishing is approve-once. Content leaves the building, so it does not auto-fire from a voice transcript.

params.brief: the topic, platform, and audience in Paras's own words

run.task:
Create this content: {brief}

Apply the per-community voice and the §4 compliance rules (education only, no income or return claims). This is a draft for Paras's review before publishing.

commands.summary: Have the content brain draft this content
commands.reply: Draft written. {preview} It's on the dashboard for your review before anything gets published.

commands.description: Review, audit, or diagnose Meta ad performance, ad spend, wasted budget, or tracking gaps.
phrases: where are we wasting ad spend
commands.gate_reason: CLAUDE.md §5 — anything touching ad spend stays human-owned. The audit is analysis only and changes nothing, but it stays gated so no ads path is ever voice-triggered.

params.brief: which account, vertical, or campaign to look at

run.task:
Audit this: {brief}

Read-only analysis — produce a prioritized fix list. Never propose a spend change as executed; budget changes stay with Paras and the ads manager.

commands.summary: Have the paid-media auditor review the ads (analysis only, no spend changes)
commands.reply: Audit done. {preview} Full fix list is on the dashboard. No spend was changed.

commands.description: Anything about the CRM — GoHighLevel contacts, tags, pipelines, opportunities, calendars, appointments, or data hygiene.
phrases: how many leads are in the funnel
commands.gate_reason: The GHL operator writes to the live CRM. A mis-heard transcript must never reach a CRM write path.

params.brief: what to check or change in GHL

run.task:
Handle this GoHighLevel request: {brief}

Start read-only: report what you find. Any write (tag, contact, pipeline, calendar change) must be listed as a proposed action for Paras's approval, not described as done.

commands.summary: Have the GHL operator inspect the CRM and propose actions
commands.reply: Done. {preview} Details are on the dashboard — proposed CRM changes are waiting on you, nothing was written.
